title: Foundation: objects, fields, record types, processes, queues, permission sets

cases.title: The 4 new objects and their design fields exist; Opportunity Key is unique
Partner Referral Lead offers only the 5 programme statuses and Lead Source "Partner Referral"
Partner Referral Opportunity offers the programme stages; other record types are unchanged
Opportunities of other record types keep their original stages
Lead conversion maps Referral, agency, agent and move-in date onto the Opportunity
Five Lead queues, "Connectnow Sales" business hours and the settings record match the design
Permission sets, groups and custom permissions exist; external sharing is Private on the new objects
Partner permission sets grant no access to Lead, Opportunity, Payout Batch or Payout Line
Seed script creates the 4 active products in the price book and is idempotent on re-run
Commission Rate is tracked in Account field history
